While the spotlight this week is on the iOS 27 public beta, Apple has also rolled out a new public beta firmware update for AirPods. This update finally delivers a long-awaited feature to supported AirPods models: custom EQ.

AirPods Public Beta Details

The AirPods public beta firmware version is 9.0.314, with build number 9A314b. The following AirPods models are eligible for the update:

  • AirPods Pro 3
  • AirPods Pro 2 (Lightning and USB-C versions)
  • AirPods 4
  • AirPods 4 (Active Noise Cancellation)
  • AirPods Max 2

You can sign up for the AirPods public beta program within the Settings app on your iPhone. When AirPods are connected, you'll see a toggle in the Settings app to enable the beta firmware. After that, as long as the AirPods are in their charging case and within range of the paired iPhone, the beta will automatically download and install.

  • Open the Settings app
  • Tap Bluetooth
  • Tap the (i) icon next to your AirPods
  • Scroll down and toggle on AirPods Beta Updates

Custom EQ Lands on AirPods

After installing the AirPods public beta, a long-awaited new feature will appear in the Settings app: custom EQ.

With the new custom EQ controls, you can now fine-tune the sound of your AirPods more precisely. In the Settings app, you can adjust the bass, mid, and treble of your AirPods.

Apple notes: "AirPods are designed and engineered by Apple to faithfully reproduce the audio of music, TV shows, movies, and calls. If you prefer a different sound profile, you can also customize how AirPods perform when playing any audio."

While adjusting custom EQ, you can directly play a song from Apple Music in the Settings app to instantly hear the effects of your changes.

This is by no means the most professional equalizer feature on the market—just a basic three-band adjustment. However, for AirPods users, this is a feature that has been long-awaited, and Apple has finally relented and made it available to everyone—though most people will probably just stick with the default settings.

You can find the new custom EQ feature under the Audio & Routing menu in the AirPods settings within the Settings app. This feature is available on all AirPods equipped with the H2 chip, including AirPods Pro 2, AirPods Pro 3, AirPods 4, and AirPods Max 2.

Other New AirPods Features in iOS 27

Here are the other new features iOS 27 brings to AirPods:

  • Redesigned Settings App: iOS 27 has redesigned the AirPods interface in the Settings app, reorganizing the controls into separate menus for hearing health, Find My, Live Translation, and more.
  • Adaptive Audio Slider: The Settings app now includes a slider for finer adjustments to the Adaptive Audio mode.
  • GymKit: Although GymKit has been around for years, it has always required an Apple Watch to use. As my colleague Zac noted, iOS 27 brings the complete GymKit experience to iPhone and AirPods Pro 3.
  • Precision Finding: You can now use Precision Finding via the Find My app on Apple Watch to locate your AirPods Pro 3.
  • Siri AI: When used with a supported iPhone, AirPods can interact with Siri AI.

Wrap-Up

Which new AirPods feature are you most looking forward to trying? Will you experiment with the new custom EQ? Let us know in the comments.
